title: Bulk Keyword CSV Export - UI Domains
excerpt: Turn keyword lists into available .com domain batches with AI or word-list combinations, then download per-keyword and combined CSV files.
content_html:
Bulk domain tools

Paste a list of keywords. Each keyword runs through the AI generator — or gets combined with curated word lists — and every available .com found is written to CSV files, one per keyword plus one combined file, packaged as a zip. Built for feeding large batches to LLMs.

One run, many keywords

Keywords are processed one at a time through the full generator pipeline.

CSV per keyword + combined

Get a zip with a CSV for each keyword and one big combined file.

Made for LLM analysis

Massive, clean lists your favorite model can comb for the best names.
